sloka: प्रवीविवक्षोरिव सागरस्य लोकान्दिधक्षोरिव पावकस्ययुगक्षये ह्येव यथान्तकस्य हनूमतः स्थास्यति कः पुरस्तात् ।। ७.३६.४९ ॥
transliteration: pravīvivakṣoriva sāgarasya lokāndidhakṣoriva pāvakasyayugakṣaye hyeva yathāntakasya hanūmataḥ sthāsyati kaḥ purastāt ।। 7.36.49 ॥

translations.english: Who indeed will be able to stand before Hanuman, who is like the ocean wishing to overflow, like fire wishing to burn the worlds, or like Yama at the end of an eon?
